subject: seewave crest: Visualize crest factor per time slot, e.g. per 100ms?

messages.author: cfda97fc2210ea87
messages.subject: seewave crest: Visualize crest factor per time slot, e.g. per 100ms?
parts:
Good afternoon

I'm not sure if I can ask this question here or if this group mainly serves the developers of seewave. But since I couldn't find any other reference were to discuss seewave issues, I'll give it a try. Please let me know if I am wrong here.

My question is related to the seewave crest factor. It is not only very useful as a single value for a whole audio file, but also a great indicator for time periods in a signal. So (I was quite surprised that one can not pass a segment size to the crest function and then get an array of crest factors.)

Therefore my question:
Would it be quite feasible with seewave to display the waveform of an audio signal and at the same time display the crest factor calculated per e.g. 100ms?

I know C# and R seems a bit strange to me. I like to do research in R, but I would be grateful if I knew beforehand whether the path leads to a useful destination 😅

Thanks a lot, kind regards,
Thomas

Hello,
I understand the point. The idea is to apply a sliding window along the signal and to compute the crest factor for each window.
I will try to do it in the next days but I cannot promise anything. 
Best
Jerome
